scope: Saved PUBLIC source C11/C12 old matched-occurrence regression inventory, prospectively declared before reading any score arrays for this task.
allowed: immutable C11/C12 selected source score arrays and saved result/baseline metadata
old public before/cover/sham GT and input lineage metadata
existing donor assignment/ownership certificates metadata only
forbidden: private/current223 or V112 data, GT, scores or model files
raw RGB/mask pixels, new image inspection or rendering
threshold/checkpoint/arm selection or new training design
cohorts: All old public accepted TRAIN and VALIDATION cover/sham pairs, plus natural BEFORE E separately. Retain all rows and use original known/factual availability; no outcome-based denominator changes.

definitions.raw_E: available and z>=0; signed zero follows saved decoder
definitions.regression: C11 correct E to C12 wrong D on same known external E row
definitions.fix: C11 wrong D to C12 correct E on same known external E row
definitions.relative_margin_ge2: z_cover-z_sham >=2, reported separately from absolute z_cover>=0
definitions.strict_cover_positive: z_cover>0 diagnostic separate from authoritative E >=0

prospective_breakdowns: TRAIN/VALIDATION natural/controlled E confusion with U retained
all accepted covers by donor object ID, source family, rank
regression and fix triplets with original base image/q/L/native slot and all before/cover/sham logits
margin>=2 with cover rawD, across all accepted covers and saved synthetic matched triplets if schema supports it
causal_limits: One reused source cohort; donor/object/rank and material/context are covariates, not randomized isolated causal effects.
Source conditional cue labels and source q association are not native/human gold.
Public diagnosis cannot establish a general material-ownership mechanism.
